item.title: LEM
item.description: About LEM The Mobile Experimental Laboratory (LEM) of the Research Center in Social Complexity (CICS) at Universidad del Desarrollo is a comprehensive and dynamic solution for conducting social science research and experiments, both on site and in the field. Its facilities and equipment provide a solid base for different experimental phases, with logistical flexibility and a high standard of scientific rigor, and allow simultaneous data collection from large groups. It is a collaborative space where students, postdocs, academics, and national and international collaborators linked to CICS work on interdisciplinary projects with a common focus: the use of experimental methods in social sciences.

item.title: Session Log
item.description: The PoliCICS working group maintains an active calendar of regular sessions, traditionally held on Thursdays at 11:30 AM. These instances constitute a fundamental space for discussing research progress, piloting experimental designs, and presenting work by both our researchers and national and international guests. Below you can see the record of the sessions held during the 2025 academic cycle, from most recent to oldest. Date Presenter Title Abstract December 4 Constanza Pino (CICS) Interventions for Food Consumption in Adult Women Through Embodiment Mechanisms In this project, food choice in adult women will be explored under the cognitive embodiment framework.
